title: Nodeology: Creating Graph-based Agentic Workflows for AI-Assisted Electron Microscopy
content: Foundation models, such as Large Language Models and Vision Language Models, have significant potential to advance scientific research by providing intuitive human–computer interfaces, processing unstructured data, enabling fuzzy logic-based automation, and generating powerful insights [1–3]. In electron microscopy, these capabilities are particularly valuable for automating complex imaging processes, including experiment control [4] and data analysis [5]. However, effectively integrating foundation models into scientific environments requires a robust framework that seamlessly combines advanced AI technologies with human expertise and established methodologies. Existing AI frameworks are often either difficult to tailor for scientific applications (e.g., AutoGen [6]) or present a steep learning curve (e.g., LangGraph [7] with its original syntax), making them less accessible to non-AI experts and general researchers.
